Tesla protocol test fixtures
============================

Do not put real vehicle private keys in this directory.

For protocol-vector tests, use Tesla's published test vectors from:

https://github.com/teslamotors/vehicle-command/blob/main/pkg/protocol/protocol.md

In particular, the protocol specification publishes the expected session
key:

1b2fce19967b79db696f909cff89ea9a

and the expected session-info HMAC key:

fceb679ee7bca756fcd441bf238bf2f338629b41d9eb9c67be1b32c9672ce300
